Jibin N Sunil

I’m a PhD student in physics at the University of Basel, studying strongly correlated electronic phases in twisted and stretched bilayer semiconductors.

3.2° Two identical lattices, one rotated. Drag across the picture or use the slider: the large pattern that appears is a moiré superlattice, the stage on which twisted-bilayer physics happens.

Research

PhD: correlated phases in twisted and stretched bilayers

University of Basel · Sept 2023 – present

Low-temperature transport in 2D semiconductor devices, including device fabrication and measurements in magnetic fields. Supervised by Dr. Andreas Baumgartner, Prof. Dominik Zumbühl and Prof. Richard Warburton (Department of Physics, Swiss Nanoscience Institute, NCCR SPIN).

Major project: 2D TMDs from first principles

IISER Thiruvananthapuram · Jul 2022 – Jul 2023

Computed and characterised electronic and optical properties of 2D transition metal dichalcogenides with Quantum Espresso, under Dr. Rajeev N Kini.

Semester project: PMMA thin films

IISER Thiruvananthapuram · Sep – Dec 2021

Characterised spin-coated polymethyl methacrylate films, under Dr. Somu Kumaragurubaran.

Summer internship: photochemistry

IISER Thiruvananthapuram · May – Jul 2019

Studied the basic principles of photochemistry and its instruments, under Prof. K. George Thomas.
